subject: Mutual Action Plan: Provisioning playbook & network/orig setup for Catalyst Health POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Provisioning playbook & network/orig setup for Catalyst Health POC

Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I put together a concise provisioning playbook that we can lock into the Mutual Action Plan this week so your team can get the POC environment up and running by the end of the month. High-level asks we need to close from your side:

1) Org & API keys
   - Add cross-account org admin for the POC (we suggest creating a dedicated service user).
   - We will issue an API key scoped to the evaluation model; request one key rotation window (we recommend 90d).

2) Network
   - IP allowlist: provide CIDR blocks (e.g. office egress + CI runners).
   - VPC peering: we need the VPC ID and owner account; we'll share our peering config and security policy.

3) Timeline & owners
   - Provisioning template attached (fill fields in column B).
   - Proposed cutover: request completed details by 2026-10-09 so we can schedule environment validation on 10/12.

I attached a short provisioning template to capture the exact values (VPC IDs, subnets, firewall rules). Can you confirm the best contact on your infra side (Marcus or someone else) and whether Catalyst requires a formal paperwork/DTIA for peering?

If helpful, Lauren can run a 30-min walkthrough to review the template and handshake on the peering steps.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Attachment: catalyst-provisioning-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@catalysthealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@catalysthealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Provisioning playbook & network/orig setup for Catalyst Health POC

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear list. Marcus is our infra lead and I'll loop him on the VPC details (cc'd). A couple of quick items from our side:

- We prefer to create the service user in our org and then add redwood-sa@catalysthealth.com as a delegated admin for the POC. Is that workflow supported?
- For IP allowlist, we have two egress ranges: 35.199.0.0/16 (CI runners) and 18.204.0.0/24 (office NAT). I will confirm if we need a CIDR for partner connectivity separately.
- For VPC peering, we require a peering agreement doc and the peering request to be initiated from our side. Can you send a template or a checklist of the exact fields you need (CIDR, VPC ID, route tables, security group exceptions)?

We'll aim to populate the attached template by 2026-10-08. If Lauren can do a short walkthrough on 10/7 or 10/8 that would be ideal — Marcus prefers mornings PST.

Best,
Priya Shah
Director, Platform Engineering | Catalyst Health
priya.shah@catalysthealth.com

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Provisioning playbook & network/orig setup for Catalyst Health POC

Priya / Marcus —

Great, thanks for the ranges — that helps. Quick notes and an action checklist so we have owners in the MAP:

A) Org & API keys (owner: Catalyst / Marcus)
  - Catalyst creates a dedicated service user (redwood-sa@catalysthealth.com) and grants it Organization Reader + Service-User role for the POC org.
  - Marcus: confirm whether SSO-only orgs require a service account bypass; if so, we can accept short-lived tokens.
  - Redwood will generate an API key once the service user is visible; key will be scoped to the evaluation model and tagged with deal_id CL-20261005-CH-014.

B) IP allowlist (owner: Catalyst / Priya)
  - Confirmed ranges received. Please add 35.199.0.0/16 and 18.204.0.0/24 to the allowlist.
  - If you have an outbound proxy, confirm that the proxy allows TLS SNI for api.redwood.ai.

C) VPC peering (owner: Catalyst infra / Marcus + Redwood infra)
  - Required fields: VPC ID, CIDR, peering contact email, route table IDs. We attached a peering diagram (vpc-peering-diagram.png) and a minimal checklist in the drive link.
  - Catalyst to initiate peering request; Redwood will accept and validate routes.

D) Validation & schedule (owner: Redwood)
  - Environment validation: Redwood will run connectivity + key validation on 2026-10-12.
  - If the template is returned by 10/08 we can keep the timeline.

Next steps:
  - Marcus: send VPC ID + peering contact by 2026-10-06 EOD.
  - Priya: confirm whether you prefer us to issue a draft peering agreement or if Catalyst will use internal legal.

I can run a 30-min walkthrough on 10/07 at 09:30 PST (invite to follow). Jonas and Karthik will cover API key lifecycle and peering validation checks.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 628-555-0142

Attachments: vpc-peering-diagram.png (image), catalyst-provisioning-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Provisioning playbook & network/orig setup for Catalyst Health POC

Quick confirmation from infra/validation perspective — thanks for the speedy replies. Final checklist items from my side before validation run:

1) Service user visible in your org + email contact for the account admin (so we can validate role bindings).
2) Filled provisioning template (VPC ID, route tables). If you prefer, Marcus can paste the values directly into the sheet and mark completed.
3) Peering agreement: a short form is fine; Marcus, if you send a link to your standard peering doc, we will confirm acceptance clauses quickly.

If everything above is ready by EOD 10/08 Redwood will execute a pre-validation run (connectivity + token auth) and we will schedule the formal validation on 10/12 morning PST. If anything slips, call out which item and we will propose a short contingency window.

I'll send a calendar invite for the 10/07 walkthrough at 09:30 PST and include a short runbook in the event notes (connectivity tests + sample curl commands).

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
